entry_points.text: Flavor dispatch uses trust-domain path for TD vCPUs else VMX for unhandleable query and MSR write-read; nested restore refuses while VMX active else dispatches by cap id; reads serve segment, sysenter, tracing and nested from hw-caches via user-return table then common; TD reads synthesize locked feat-ctl and MCG-ext subject to cap then emulate-check.

LBR creation reuses event marking fixed branch in use else creates pinned host-excluded branch-stack counter tracking use bit and logging failure; intercept refresh bypasses TDs else refreshes instr-MSR; emulated-MSR completion dispatches by kind with TD reporting invalid-operand on error else publishing data regs.
Per-entry prep consumes L1 controls plus emulated-entry flag, refreshes shadow and guest state, reports ok or invalid with default code; restored-state check needs shadow plus exec-host-guest checks.

exports.text: Visible helpers: capability query maps VMX index to cached halves, conventional and trust-domain writers with emulated-set predicate use accept or caller-fail status, plus intercept-clear, wait-package check, guest-host sampler and kernel-GS reader.

hazards.text: Dump must not deref possibly corrupt exception addr, use known VA noting mismatch; unexpected TD emulation flag warns once; control and fixed0 selectors trap on unknown ids; SMI on TD is bug, busy when nested run pending else allowed only outside SMM; entry prep fails on bad state, CR3 or perf; malformed pages may defer failure via illegal pointer until entry.

Stable IDs: VMX basic-pin-proc-exit-entry-secondary-misc-fixed-EPT-VPID-enum-func; tracing ctl-status-output-mask-match-range; IA32 VMX family with EPT low and VPID high; posted, XSAVES and MBEC are single-bit tests; EPTP from L1 ptr with AD bit inside; x2APIC window 256 from 2048 with read-write halves; link uses invalid sentinel, revision and area size.

invariants.text: Externally visible PML drain checks empty, derives overflow-aware tail, marks dirty head-downward expecting page alignment with warn on misalignment then resets index; nested cleanup dirties access, APIC and posted mappings when present; dump gated by enable flag with rate-limited notice, reads controls by capability, prefers loaded EFER then autoload then host value adjusted for long mode.

Trust-domain set covers poll control, MCG status-cap-ctl-extctl, platform info, MTRR def-cap plus fixed range, TSC deadline, PAT, power, arch caps, misc enables, APIC base, EFER, feat ctl, bank controls and xAPIC timer-error-LVT-ICR-SPIV-LDR-ID subset excluding hw-virtualized, with 3-member read-only subset; writes check host origin, caps, canonical form and reserved bits, mirror entry-debug-bound-PAT to nested copies when nested, reject with caller-fail and refresh fill-buffer state.

Restore uses masked subset check; basic checks features, polarity, revision, size; controls need low-set high-clear halves; misc preserves timer rate, bounds and revision; EPT-VPID split host bits and fixed0 needs host-set bits; non-true, fixed-derived and unknown refused, enum cached, func cached if clean, per vCPU; reads allow host and gate guest on caps; emulation covers SMBASE, nesting, AMD negatives; tracing rejects reserved, active reconfig, bad encodings and range overflow, needs alignment and legal GPA; feature respects lock and allowed sets; debug gates bus-lock, branch-record and TM bits with legacy tolerance; sysenter narrows without long mode.

MSR intercepts no-op without bitmap else pass time, segment and syscall regs plus power-freq when exits disabled, gate tracing, speculation, shadow, branch and CET on guest caps; PMU inert unless mediated then toggles perf-global with autostore fallback, passes owned counters, intercepts unowned plus status-overflow by need; instr refresh follows counter-read need; perf caps zero without leaf and fw-write from one bit; halt clears only permitted halt to active; timer scales L1 time, caches deadline, zero expires sync, zero freq disables, else arms pinned absolute timer flagging expiry, requesting events and kicking.

Shadow entry from host absorbs L1 except perf-global, clears EFER bits then re-sets on support via long-mode and compare; exit reuses host with EFER-load only on differ; pin-basic-secondary merged with masking, posted and virt feats from L1, unconditional port exits, no logging or shadowing; VPID uses L2 id only if L1 enabled else L1 id; one-time init fixes store-load addrs, VE addr, bitmap, disables VMFUNC-PML, blocks ENCLS, sets posted vector and notify window; prep merges traps, narrows CR0 mask, composes TSC offset-scale via exported L2 accessors, flushes TLB, switches EPT, installs mask-aware CR-EFER deriving EPT exec-level from caps-AD-MBEC; event inject copies intr state when pending else clears.

Per-entry flags from L1 with debug-CET-bound-PAT on load bits else saved or arch values, XSAVES-EOI-APIC gating, segment-table-sysenter refresh by dirty groups with cache invalidate and CR4 mask refresh; faults force every exit when host needs intercepts else L1 mask-match; TSC appended temporarily when L1 stores on exit with overflow guard, list walk fails on unreadable; exported guest check permissive under unrestricted else real-protected segment rules; real needs fixed base-limit-rights, code-stack-data need usable-present-sys-priv rules, TR-LDTR need types, CS-SS RPL agree.

CR accepted under fixed masks with relaxed prot-page under unrestricted, rejects paging-without-prot, CET-without-WP and 64bit-without-longmode, pending EFER needs validity and coherence; debug-PAT-perf-bound-CET checked only on load with freeze-bit quirk and CET alignment-canonicality; link sentinel passes else needs valid GPA, readable page, revision and shadow match, activity active-halt-wait; pin-primary-secondary satisfy masks plus count, IO, MSR, shadow, APIC, NMI, log, unrestricted, MBEC, VPID nonzero, timer-save implies timer, EPT valid, func-list valid and timescale nonzero.

Page setup reloads PAE then maps APIC-access, virt-APIC and posted pages, missing backing fails clearing posted or programming illegal addr to fail entry, bitmap use follows outcome; bitmap prep skipped without hw-guest enable or enlightened no-change else maps guest RO, seeds host to intercept x2APIC window, relaxes priority-completion-selfIPI under virt modes and merges host policy for segment, speculation, freq, CET, stack and counter families.

locks.text: User-return and guest-host updates disable preemption across hw programming, refreshing cache only after success or when loaded else returning cached value.

state_machines.text: PML follows empty check, tail derive, ordered dirty then reset; tracing interception follows enable, intercepting status, output, match and range pairs while inactive.

SMM enter records guest-nested context, exits to host, deactivates nesting and clears halt; leave restores nesting, revalidates and schedules reentry faulting on bad state; nested entry saves host ctx, switches to L2, merges-validates-loads, reevaluates events, arms timer, unwinds time-flush-mode-pages-host state on fail with invalid or MSR-load reason.

structs.text: Mapping uses nonzero host addr for validity and guest frame for dirty; capability query maps VMX index to cached halves combining low-high with legacy forcing always-on bits.
User-return entries carry load flag, mask and data with slot from table position; kernel-GS writes use shared guest-host writer programming hw when loaded then updating cache.
